subject: Stair surface ownership, rounded snow edges, both conifers, cottage materials, calm water and cultivated barley beds
limits: Finite views and exact frozen readbacks do not prove absence of every possible depth conflict.
Earlier tests missed the exactly coplanar lowest stair tread. The actual geometric clearance now has an independent regression.
New close-detail yaw steps scale to view distance; original cameras and all thresholds are unchanged. Initial wide close-plum failure preserved in close-plum-wide-sweep.json.
Full scene-object reflection and camera-driven scenery LOD are not implemented.
